notes.body:
We really enjoy the new plot dialog as it is very useful for automotive trace analysis. We want to contribute some really useful features.

This MR is about adding Markers to make multi graph analysis easier.

Example screenshot to understand what this MR adds:
![image](/uploads/e9e43e113b0c075aabc46a89a9a2eabc/image.png){width=969 height=461}

See also #18605 for a similar enhancement request for the I/O Graph.
Interesting. I guess we could enhance pcpang with special "trigger/markers/comments" and the plot dialog with that feature first and then port back to IO graph.
We are going to look into that but that will be another MR.

I don't recall if we explicitly mention this anywhere, but files under *ui/qt* follow the convention of CamelCase class names (because that's what Qt does) with snake_case filenames (because that's what we typically do). This and customplot_marker.h should probably be marker_dialog.{cpp,h}.

+Add Marker::
+
+Add marker with x-axis of current mouse position.
+
+Move Marker::
+
+Moves the selected marker to a specific x-axis position provided by the user.
+
+Show Pos Marker::
+
+Show or hide the pos marker, you can then change it to the desired position by dragging and dropping it or left click.
+
+Show Differences::
+
+User can show or hide the difference between markers.
+
+Show Data Point Marker::
+
+User can show or hide data point marker.
+
+Delete Marker::
+
+Delete the selected marker.
+
+Delete All::
+
+Delete all markers, including the Pos Marker "P".
+
 The main dialog buttons along the bottom let you do the following:
